body:
This PR migrates the `analytics` widget to TypeScript.

I added a `dispose` method to clear the side effects created during `init`.

To ease the review, you can check https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/7cf252631bfcd84e8fce8df3f748f7c57e9fca82 which is the diff after renaming the files.
